explication: Model Optimizer is a model-compression and inference-optimization library. The principal workflow is to bring in a PyTorch, Hugging Face, or ONNX model, apply one or more optimization techniques, export an optimized checkpoint, and use it in an inference framework. Its major documented capabilities include quantization, pruning, NAS, distillation, speculative decoding, and sparsity. The tree identifies these implementation areas; only selected files were sampled, so internal call wiring is shown conservatively.
